Articles relating to [[organizational theory]], which consists of many approaches to [[organizational analysis]]. "[[Organization]]s" are defined as social units of people that are structured and managed to meet a need, or to pursue collective goals. Theories of organizations include rational system perspective, [[division of labor]], [[Bureaucracy#Theories|bureaucratic theory]], and [[contingency theory]].
